profile.title: Yu Guo
content: Recently, my work has centered on adapting and fine-tuning large generative foundation models for creative workflows, including diffusion models, video generation models, and multimodal systems.

I am especially interested in combining graphics priors with modern GenAI models to make visual assets more controllable, editable, relightable, and physically consistent across images, videos, materials, and 3D scenes.

contact.title: Contact
content: A small note on the wall for the practical exits from the room.

sirr.title: SIRR-LMM: Single-image Reflection Removal via Large Multimodal Model
sirr.meta: Yu Guo, Zhiqiang Lao, Xiyun Song, Yubin Zhou, Heather Yu. WACV Workshops, 2026.
content: The reflective frame glass opens SIRR-LMM, a single-image reflection removal approach using synthetic reflection scenarios and a large multimodal model.

faces.title: 3D Faces are Recognized More Accurately and Faster than 2D Faces, but with Similar Inversion Effects
faces.meta: Derric Eng, Belle Yick, Yu Guo, Hong Xu, Miriam Reiner, TJ Cham, SH Chen. Vision Research, 2017.
content: The bust sculpture points to earlier vision work comparing recognition performance for 3D and 2D faces under upright and inverted presentation.

beyond-mie.hover: Beyond Mie Theory - frosted glass lamp
beyond-mie.title: Beyond Mie Theory: Systematic Computation of Bulk Scattering Parameters based on Microphysical Wave Optics
beyond-mie.meta: Yu Guo, Adrian Jarabo, Shuang Zhao. ACM Transactions on Graphics, 2021.
content: The glowing frosted lamp opens the scattering work: computing bulk scattering parameters beyond the far-field assumptions of Lorenz-Mie theory.

bigs.title: BiGS: Bidirectional Gaussian Primitives for Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting
bigs.meta: Relightable 3D Gaussian splatting work listed on Google Scholar.
content: The 3D printed ornament opens BiGS, a relightable 3D Gaussian representation designed for more expressive appearance and lighting control.

tryon.title: A Virtual Try-on System for Prescription Eyeglasses
tryon.meta: Qian Zhang, Yu Guo, Pierre-Yves Laffont, Tobias Martin, Markus Gross. IEEE Computer Graphics and Applications, 2017.
content: The glasses open a virtual try-on system that models corrective-lens distortion, reflections, and shading for a more realistic mirror-like result.

deformable.title: Textureless Deformable Object Tracking with Invisible Markers
deformable.meta: Textureless deformable tracking work listed on Google Scholar.
content: The squishy toy maps to deformable tracking: estimating motion and deformation for objects that lack visible texture cues.

video-editing.title: Physically Based Video Editing
video-editing.meta: Jean-Charles Bazin, Claudia Pluss, Yu Guo, Tobias Martin, Alec Jacobson, Markus Gross. Computer Graphics Forum, 2016.
content: The monitor opens video editing work that combines image-aware editing with physically based simulation to produce plausible video manipulations.

epbr.title: ePBR: Extended PBR Materials in Image Synthesis
epbr.meta: Yu Guo, Zhiqiang Lao, Xiyun Song, Yubin Zhou, Zongfang Lin, Heather Yu. CVPR Workshops, 2025.
content: The transparent trophy opens ePBR, which extends PBR-style image decomposition with reflection and transmission for materials such as glass and windows.

grain-sand.hover: Seeing a 3D world in a grain of sand - figure
grain-sand.title: Seeing A 3D World in A Grain of Sand
grain-sand.meta: 3D reconstruction / perception work listed on Google Scholar.
content: The figurine opens the grain-of-sand project, a newer work on seeing and recovering 3D structure from tiny visual evidence.

layered-bsdf.title: Position-Free Monte Carlo Simulation for Arbitrary Layered BSDFs
layered-bsdf.meta: Yu Guo, Milos Hasan, Shuang Zhao. ACM Transactions on Graphics, 2018.
content: The helmet maps to layered appearance: an unbiased Monte Carlo model for arbitrary layered BSDFs with surface and volumetric scattering.

fabric.title: Fiber-Level Woven Fabric Capture from a Single Photo
fabric.meta: Woven fabric appearance capture work listed on Google Scholar.
content: The semi-translucent curtains map to fabric capture: recovering detailed woven-fiber appearance from limited image input.

path.title: Academic Journey
content: The map traces the route behind the room: education, research appointments, internships, and industry research.
details: Changsha - B.S. in Mathematics, Central South University.
Beijing / Shenzhen - M.S. in Computer Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences / SIAT.
Singapore - Research Associate, Nanyang Technological University and BeingThere Centre.
Irvine - Ph.D. in Computer Science, University of California, Irvine.

bayesian.title: A Bayesian Inference Framework for Procedural Material Parameter Estimation
bayesian.meta: Yu Guo, Milos Hasan, Lingqi Yan, Shuang Zhao. Computer Graphics Forum, 2020.
content: The patterned wall opens procedural material estimation: fitting editable material models from photographs with optimization and Bayesian inference.

materialgan.title: MaterialGAN: Reflectance Capture using a Generative SVBRDF Model
materialgan.meta: Yu Guo, Cameron Smith, Milos Hasan, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Shuang Zhao. ACM Transactions on Graphics, 2020.
content: The wooden desktop opens the material-capture work: reconstructing spatially varying BRDFs from limited photographs using a generative SVBRDF prior.
